Day 22: Today I counted twenty-two days of vigilance. Derek still thinks he owns the station-fountain. I found a red feather, which is not a feather, and a crumb of baklava, which I ate with the precision of a man who has never been wrong. Pino is still pretending he’s not a to-do list in a body.
